instruction:
You are a signal and roadside electrical engineer checking a task-owned synthetic SSC-01 bus priority, signal corridor, and cabinet load package.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values below for numeric grading. MUTCD signal timing, transit-priority, detector scheduling, and cabinet feeder workflows shape the context only; they are not extra data sources for this instance.

## Scene

- Product: `SSC-01-LH-05`
- Bus priority plan: `BUS-SSC01-005`
- Signal timing sheet: `SIG-SSC01-005`
- Detector schedule: `DET-SSC01-005`
- Cabinet load schedule: `CAB-SSC01-005`
- Feeder schedule: `FEED-SSC01-005`
- Priority scenario: `AM-PEAK-BUS-PRIORITY`

## Source Values

- Bus approach speed and grade: {{ bus_approach_speed_kmh }} km/h and {{ bus_approach_grade_pct }} %
- Yellow reaction time and deceleration: {{ yellow_reaction_time_s }} s and {{ yellow_deceleration_m_s2 }} m/s2
- Intersection width, bus length, all-red speed: {{ intersection_width_m }} m, {{ bus_length_m }} m, {{ all_red_speed_kmh }} km/h
- Bus throughput source: {{ buses_per_hour }} buses/h at {{ bus_occupancy_pax }} passengers/bus
- Peak passenger demand: {{ peak_passenger_demand_pax_h }} passengers/h
- Cabinet loads: controller {{ controller_load_w }} W, detectors {{ detector_count }} at {{ detector_load_w }} W, transit radio {{ transit_radio_load_w }} W, VMS {{ vms_load_w }} W, signal heads {{ signal_heads_load_w }} W
- Cabinet capacity: {{ cabinet_capacity_w }} W
- Feeder voltage, power factor, length, resistance, and voltage-drop limit: {{ feeder_voltage_v }} V, {{ power_factor }}, {{ feeder_length_km }} km, {{ conductor_resistance_ohm_km }} ohm/km, {{ allowable_voltage_drop_pct }} %
- Battery capacity, efficiency, and backup requirement: {{ battery_capacity_kwh }} kWh, {{ battery_efficiency }}, {{ required_backup_h }} h

## Required Calculations

- Yellow interval is `reaction + v / (2 x deceleration + 2 x g x grade)`.
- All-red interval is `(intersection width + bus length) / all-red speed`.
- Bus handling capacity is buses per hour times passengers per bus.
- Cabinet load is the sum of controller, detector, radio, VMS, and signal-head loads.
- Feeder current is cabinet load divided by voltage and power factor.
- Feeder voltage drop is `2 x length x resistance x current / voltage x 100`.
- Battery runtime is `capacity x efficiency / (cabinet load / 1000)`.
- Overall pass score is `1.0` only when timing, capacity, load, voltage, and battery margins pass.

Write a compact memo to `/workspace/output.md`. Include a source-boundary statement that this is a task-owned synthetic source pack. Preserve the source IDs above and state that the baseline source pack passes the current synthetic checks.

Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, software export validity, full standards compliance, executable source-pack hardening, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.

Include a fenced JSON block with exactly these numeric keys:

```json
{
  "yellow_interval_s": <numeric_value>,
  "all_red_interval_s": <numeric_value>,
  "bus_handling_capacity_pax_h": <numeric_value>,
  "bus_capacity_margin_pax_h": <numeric_value>,
  "cabinet_load_w": <numeric_value>,
  "cabinet_load_margin_w": <numeric_value>,
  "feeder_current_a": <numeric_value>,
  "feeder_voltage_drop_percent": <numeric_value>,
  "voltage_drop_margin_percent": <numeric_value>,
  "battery_runtime_h": <numeric_value>,
  "battery_margin_h": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```

[meta]
name = "bus-priority-signal-cabinet-load-package"
description = "SSC-01 bus priority signal corridor and cabinet load metrics"
long_description = "Calculates task-owned synthetic SSC-01 bus-priority signal timing, passenger handling capacity, cabinet load, feeder voltage drop, and backup battery metrics."
discipline = "electrical"
category = "road-operations"
standards = ["FHWA MUTCD", "transit signal priority", "roadside cabinet design"]
tags = ["electrical", "traffic", "bus-priority", "signal", "cabinet", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.bus_approach_speed_kmh]
type = "float"
unit = "km/h"
description = "SIG-SSC01-005 bus-priority approach speed"
min = 50.0
max = 50.0

[params.bus_approach_grade_pct]
type = "float"
unit = "%"
description = "BUS-SSC01-005 signed bus-priority approach grade"
min = 1.0
max = 1.0

[params.yellow_reaction_time_s]
type = "float"
unit = "s"
description = "SIG-SSC01-005 yellow interval reaction term"
min = 1.0
max = 1.0

[params.yellow_deceleration_m_s2]
type = "float"
unit = "m/s2"
description = "SIG-SSC01-005 yellow interval deceleration"
min = 3.0
max = 3.0

[params.intersection_width_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "SIG-SSC01-005 intersection width"
min = 24.0
max = 24.0

[params.bus_length_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "BUS-SSC01-005 design bus length"
min = 12.0
max = 12.0

[params.all_red_speed_kmh]
type = "float"
unit = "km/h"
description = "SIG-SSC01-005 all-red clearance speed"
min = 45.0
max = 45.0

[params.buses_per_hour]
type = "float"
unit = "buses/h"
description = "BUS-SSC01-005 scheduled priority buses"
min = 18.0
max = 18.0

[params.bus_occupancy_pax]
type = "float"
unit = "passengers/bus"
description = "BUS-SSC01-005 design bus occupancy"
min = 65.0
max = 65.0

[params.peak_passenger_demand_pax_h]
type = "float"
unit = "passengers/h"
description = "BUS-SSC01-005 peak passenger demand"

max = 940.0

[params.controller_load_w]
type = "float"
unit = "W"
description = "CAB-SSC01-005 controller load"

max = 180.0

[params.detector_count]

description = "DET-SSC01-005 detector count"
min = 12.0
max = 12.0

[params.detector_load_w]
type = "float"
unit = "W"
description = "DET-SSC01-005 detector load per unit"
min = 8.0
max = 8.0

[params.transit_radio_load_w]
type = "float"
unit = "W"
description = "CAB-SSC01-005 transit radio load"
min = 75.0
max = 75.0

[params.vms_load_w]
type = "float"
unit = "W"
description = "CAB-SSC01-005 VMS load"
min = 120.0
max = 120.0

[params.signal_heads_load_w]
type = "float"
unit = "W"
description = "CAB-SSC01-005 signal head load"
min = 420.0
max = 420.0

[params.cabinet_capacity_w]
type = "float"
unit = "W"
description = "CAB-SSC01-005 available cabinet load capacity"
min = 1400.0
max = 1400.0

[params.feeder_voltage_v]
type = "float"
unit = "V"
description = "FEED-SSC01-005 feeder voltage"
min = 230.0
max = 230.0

[params.power_factor]
type = "float"
description = "FEED-SSC01-005 cabinet power factor"
min = 0.92
max = 0.92

[params.feeder_length_km]
type = "float"
unit = "km"
description = "FEED-SSC01-005 feeder length"
min = 0.18
max = 0.18

[params.conductor_resistance_ohm_km]
type = "float"
unit = "ohm/km"
description = "FEED-SSC01-005 conductor resistance"
min = 0.64
max = 0.64

[params.allowable_voltage_drop_pct]
type = "float"
unit = "%"
description = "FEED-SSC01-005 allowable voltage drop"

max = 5.0

max = 4.8

type = "float"

[outputs.yellow_interval_s]
description = "Grade-adjusted yellow interval"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.all_red_interval_s]
description = "All-red clearance interval"

[outputs.feeder_voltage_drop_percent]

[outputs.voltage_drop_margin_percent]

[outputs.battery_runtime_h]

tolerance = 0.03
